---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Your Name"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
births_tibble <- readxl::read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  dplyr::mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
#| message: false
average_births <- births_tibble |>
  dplyr::group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(average_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")

ggplot2::ggplot(
  average_births |>
    dplyr::mutate(month = factor(month, levels = 12:1, labels = rev(month.name))),
  ggplot2::aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = average_births)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile() +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous("Day of month", breaks = seq(1, 31, by = 5)) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c("Mean births") +
  ggplot2::labs(y = "Month")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  dplyr::filter(month == 12) |>
  dplyr::group_by(year) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    december_25_births = sum(births[date_of_month == 25]),
    surrounding_days_average = mean(
      births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]
    ),
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25][1],
    pct_of_baseline = 100 * december_25_births / surrounding_days_average,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_births
```

```{r}
#| message: false
ggplot2::ggplot(christmas_births, ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
births_model <- stats::lm(births ~ year + month + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)
summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
#| message: false
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct_resid = stats::residuals(births_model) / mean(births) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  dplyr::filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(calendar_date)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
#| message: false
holiday_dips <- calendar_resid |>
  dplyr::filter(
    calendar_date %in% as.Date(c("2001-01-01", "2001-07-04", "2001-12-25"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    holiday = c("New Year's Day", "Independence Day", "Christmas Day"),
    label_date = as.Date(c("2001-01-16", "2001-07-14", "2001-12-10")),
    label_y = c(-23, -19.5, -40)
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  calendar_resid,
  ggplot2::aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = holiday_dips) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = holiday_dips,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = calendar_date,
      y = mean_pct_resid,
      xend = label_date,
      yend = label_y
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_label(
    data = holiday_dips,
    ggplot2::aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = holiday),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0.5,
    label.size = 0,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Calendar date", y = "Mean residual (% of mean births)")
```
